posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked: Heroes have 40 cards plus one character card (not including promotionals). Villians have 25 cards plus two character cards. Environment has 15 cards.
posts.raw: Heroes have 40 cards plus one character card (not including promotionals).  Villians have 25 cards plus two character cards.  Environment has 15 cards.
